newsitem.title: USA: New Jersey partnership has Bettis stake.
newsitem.headline: New Jersey partnership has Bettis stake.

text.p: Alpine Associates, a Cresskill, N.J., limited partnership in the brokerage business, said it has acquired 441,100 shares of Bettis Corp. common stock, or 5.2 percent of the total outstanding.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, Alpine, which is controlled by Victoria Eckert, said it acquired the stake for $2,549,635, for investment purposes.
Alpine said its stake includes 177,200 shares that were purchased between Sept. 20 and Nov. 15 at prices ranging from $7.00 to $7.9375.
